column1: # Config-scoped shard exclusions -- the sanctioned-skip ledger of the fan-out
# census (round-2, 2026-10-22). One 'os<TAB>config<TAB>shard<TAB>cause' row
# per (arm, shard) that the arm is DECLARED unable to run. A shard listed
# here must NOT produce its .attest file but MUST produce its .excl marker
# (rendered by the aggregator's --write-exclusion-marker from this row, so
# the marker can never drift from the ledger); any other combination --
# missing marker, rogue marker, or an attestation under an active exclusion
# -- is a DEFECT. Exclusion is thus louder than silence: the arm still
# carries a witnessed, censused record of why it ran nothing here.
# ubuntu-latest/4.3, shard 3 (its sole file test-xval-m2-extract.R is fully
# gated on sigminer -- skip_if_not_installed() guards its one test_that at
# the top, so 4.3 has no runnable surface there to lose): the M2 xval
# reference is not installable at R 4.3. Both sigminer 2.3.3 (the pinned
# ground truth) and CRAN 2.4.0 Import maftools, whose Imports (VariantTools,
# S4Vectors) are Bioconductor Software packages of the 3.18 release series;
# the 3.18 trees answer 404 on every canonical mirror as measured 2026-10-22
# (bioconductor.posit.co/packages/3.18/* and bioconductor.org old-release
# paths 404, while the live 3.21 series answers 200). Installing a
# half-resolved reference and calling the shard green is the vacuous-green
# this census exists to refuse; the xval pillar is carried by every other
# arm of the fan-out, and that carriage is itself attested: the same census
# demands shard 3's attestation with executed >= 1 on each of them. Consumed
# by tools/ci/ci-shard-aggregate.py (--exclusions) and gated for shape by
# tools/ci-selfcheck.py.
ubuntu-latest
